summary: Implemented the endpoint-resolver builtin helper. Changes: botocore/regions.py adds the EndpointResolverBuiltins(str, Enum) registry with all eleven members and comments; botocore/args.py adds the EPRBuiltins import, makes the STS predicate accept a None endpoint configuration, and adds ClientArgsCreator.compute_endpoint_resolver_builtin_defaults; tests/unit/test_args.py adds TestEndpointResolverBuiltins with one test per behavioral criterion. Results: tests/unit/test_args.py passes (59 tests). The full unit suite has 11 failures, identical before and after the change (verified by diffing the failure lists), so none come from this work. Not verified: black and isort are not installed in the shared venv, so formatting was checked by hand only; the one over-79-column line in args.py is pre-existing. Nothing was committed. Choices: SDK::Endpoint is present as None when absent; falsy FIPS/DualStack become False; a None s3_config is normalised to {}.
